proposed_comments.title: The en-us resource is included twice

confidence.rationale: The pinned project includes the en-us resource explicitly and in the wildcard list, then promotes wildcard items into PRIResource.

proposed_comments.body:
### The en-us resource is included twice

**Severity:** `medium`

The project includes `Strings\en-us\Resources.resw` explicitly as a `PRIResource`, then the wildcard also selects that same file and `AddWildCardItems` adds it to `PRIResource` again. This can feed the same locale resource into PRI generation twice; keep the explicit designer item and exclude en-us from the wildcard list.

```suggestion
    <_WildCardPRIResource Include="Strings\*\Resources.resw" />
    <_WildCardPRIResource Remove="Strings\en-us\Resources.resw" />
```

proposed_comments.title: Match the Title Case resource keys to the XAML UID

confidence.rationale: The pinned XAML UID uses ToggleButton_TitleCase, while both changed resource values remain under ToggleButton_Titlecase keys.

proposed_comments.body:
### Match the Title Case resource keys to the XAML UID

**Severity:** `medium`

The Title Case button uses `x:Uid="ToggleButton_TitleCase"`, but both resource entries still use `ToggleButton_Titlecase` with a lowercase `c`. Because the resource keys do not match the UID, the updated tooltip and automation name are not associated with that button. Rename both `data` keys to `ToggleButton_TitleCase` and verify the tooltip and accessible name resolve in the UI.
